The project is in `./app` and `mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests test-compile` passes (BUILD SUCCESS). I did not run `@QuarkusTest` or call a model.

- **`POST /ask`:** it takes `{"question": "..."}` and returns `{"answer": "..."}`. Blank or over-long (4,000-character) questions get a 400 before any model call.
- **Q&A over the documents:** the question goes to `DocsAssistant`, which answers from the Markdown files. Easy RAG loads them into an in-memory store at startup. I used a bundled in-process `bge-small` embedding model, so no embedding service is needed.
- **Sample document:** `src/main/resources/rag/acme-docs-overview.md`. The loader only picks up `.md` files from that folder.
- **Ollama:** the model is `qwen3:4b`, configured as a named `main` model. You need `ollama serve` and `ollama pull qwen3:4b` locally. Dev Services are off, so no container starts.
- **Extras:** I added a guardrail that rejects over-long input and obvious prompt-injection text. I also added a 120-second timeout with a "temporarily unavailable" fallback message, and RFC 9457 error responses.
- **Test:** `DocsAssistantTest` checks that the AI service is wired. It needs no live model.

Quarkus platform is 3.40.1 and the compiler release is 25. I called `quarkus_create` through the Quarkus MCP, and it started dev mode on its own. I stopped it before editing, and I did not run `git init` or commit. The conventions file says the MCP needs the project under git, so its other tools (`quarkus_start`, `quarkus_skills`) may refuse until you run `git init` in `./app`.

I did not call `quarkus_skills` or context7, so the Easy RAG property names (`path`, `path-matcher`, `max-results`) are unchecked. The compile doesn't validate them, so a startup run would.
